```{r}
# --- figure output redirected to _organized/figures/ ---
# Data files and CSV/RDS outputs keep their original paths.
fig_dir <- "../../../figures/data_analysis/ex_sensor_matrix"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

folder_path <- "../../project1_ex/sensor"

csv_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# 分出 output, answer, 和数据文件
output_file <- csv_files[grepl("output\\.csv$", csv_files)]
answer_file <- csv_files[grepl("sensor_answer\\.csv$", csv_files)]
data_files  <- csv_files[!grepl("output\\.csv$", csv_files) & 
                         !grepl("sensor_answer\\.csv$", csv_files)]

# 读取 output 和 answer
output <- read.csv(output_file, header = TRUE)
cat("output 已读取：", nrow(output), "行，", ncol(output), "列\n")

answer <- read.csv(answer_file, header = TRUE)
cat("answer 已读取：", nrow(answer), "行，", ncol(answer), "列\n")

# 读取其余文件为 dat_1, dat_2...
for (i in seq_along(data_files)) {
  tryCatch({
    dat <- read.csv(data_files[i], header = TRUE)
    assign(paste0("dat_", i), dat)
    cat(paste0("dat_", i, " 已读取：", basename(data_files[i]),
               "（", nrow(dat), " 行，", ncol(dat), " 列）\n"))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(paste0("跳过：", basename(data_files[i]), " -> ", e$message, "\n"))
  })
}
rm(dat)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

# =========================================================
# Step 1. 构建 RT 矩阵（行 = Video，列 = participant）
# 同一个 Video × participant 如果有多条 trial，先取 mean
# =========================================================
rt_wide <- all_cat %>%
  dplyr::select(Video, participant, key_resp_9.rt) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key_resp_9.rt)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = participant,
    values_from = key_resp_9.rt,
    values_fn   = mean
  )

rt_matrix <- rt_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Video") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("RT 矩阵维度：", dim(rt_matrix), "\n")
cat("视频数：", nrow(rt_matrix), "\n")
cat("被试数：", ncol(rt_matrix), "\n")
cat("缺失值数量：", sum(is.na(rt_matrix)), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 2. 每列 z-score（按 participant 标准化）
# 去掉不同被试整体快慢差异
# =========================================================
rt_zscored <- scale(rt_matrix, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# 去掉标准化后没有信息的列
keep_cols <- colSums(!is.na(rt_zscored)) > 1
rt_zscored <- rt_zscored[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

cat("标准化后矩阵维度：", dim(rt_zscored), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 3. 计算 RDM
# 比较的是 video 和 video 之间的 dissimilarity
# correlation distance = 1 - Pearson correlation
# =========================================================
rdm_rt <- 1 - cor(
  t(rt_zscored),
  method = "pearson",
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

# 保证行列名是 Video
rownames(rdm_rt) <- rownames(rt_zscored)
colnames(rdm_rt) <- rownames(rt_zscored)

cat("RDM 维度：", dim(rdm_rt), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 4. 可视化
# =========================================================
pheatmap(
  rdm_rt,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  main = "Human RDM - RT"
)

# =========================================================
# Step 5. 保存
# =========================================================
saveRDS(rdm_rt, "human_rdm_rt.rds")
write.csv(rdm_rt, "human_rdm_rt.csv")
```

rdm-correctness
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

# =========================================================
# Step 1. 构建 correctness 矩阵（行 = Video，列 = participant）
# 同一个 Video × participant 如果有多条 trial，先取 mean
# 这样每个 cell 表示该 participant 对该 video 的正确率
# =========================================================
corr_wide <- all_cat %>%
  dplyr::select(Video, participant, key_resp_9.corr) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key_resp_9.corr)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = participant,
    values_from = key_resp_9.corr,
    values_fn   = mean
  )

corr_matrix <- corr_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Video") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("Correctness 矩阵维度：", dim(corr_matrix), "\n")
cat("视频数：", nrow(corr_matrix), "\n")
cat("被试数：", ncol(corr_matrix), "\n")
cat("缺失值数量：", sum(is.na(corr_matrix)), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 2. 计算 RDM
# 用平均绝对差（适合 binary / proportion correctness）
# d(i,j) = mean(|x_i - x_j|)
# =========================================================
video_ids <- rownames(corr_matrix)
n_video <- nrow(corr_matrix)

rdm_corr <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = n_video,
  ncol = n_video,
  dimnames = list(video_ids, video_ids)
)

for (i in seq_len(n_video)) {
  for (j in i:n_video) {
    xi <- corr_matrix[i, ]
    xj <- corr_matrix[j, ]
    
    keep <- !is.na(xi) & !is.na(xj)
    
    if (sum(keep) == 0) {
      d <- NA_real_
    } else {
      d <- mean(abs(xi[keep] - xj[keep]))
    }
    
    rdm_corr[i, j] <- d
    rdm_corr[j, i] <- d
  }
}

cat("RDM 维度：", dim(rdm_corr), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 3. 可视化
# =========================================================
pheatmap(
  rdm_corr,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  main = "Human RDM - Correctness"
)

# =========================================================
# Step 4. 保存
# =========================================================
save_path <- "."

if (!dir.exists(save_path)) {
  dir.create(save_path, recursive = TRUE)
}

saveRDS(rdm_corr, file.path(save_path, "human_rdm_corr.rds"))
write.csv(rdm_corr, file.path(save_path, "human_rdm_corr.csv"), row.names = TRUE)

write.csv(corr_wide, file.path(save_path, "corr_wide.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ── Step 2: 每列计算 z-score ──────────────────────────
rt_zscored <- scale(rt_matrix, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# ── Step 3: 跑 PCA ───────────────────────────────────
pca_rt <- prcomp(rt_zscored, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

# ── Step 4: 查看方差解释 ──────────────────────────────
var_explained <- summary(pca_rt)$importance
cat("=== 各 PC 方差解释 ===\n")
print(round(var_explained[, 1:10], 3))

# 找到解释 80% 和 90% 方差所需的 PC 数量
cum_var <- cumsum(pca_rt$sdev^2 / sum(pca_rt$sdev^2))
k_80 <- which(cum_var >= 0.80)[1]
k_90 <- which(cum_var >= 0.90)[1]
cat("\n解释 80% 方差需要", k_80, "个 PC\n")
cat("解释 90% 方差需要", k_90, "个 PC\n")

# ── Step 5: 可视化方差解释 ───────────────────────────
plot(cum_var, type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "Number of PCs",
     ylab = "Cumulative Variance Explained",
     main = "Sensorimotor - RT PCA")
abline(h = 0.80, col = "blue", lty = 2)
abline(h = 0.90, col = "red",  lty = 2)
legend("bottomright",
       legend = c("80%", "90%"),
       col    = c("blue", "red"),
       lty    = 2)

# ── Step 6: 每个视频在每个 PC 上的得分 ──────────────
pc_scores <- pca_rt$x
cat("\n=== 视频 PC 得分（前5行，前5个PC）===\n")
print(round(pc_scores[1:5, 1:5], 3))

# ── Step 7: 每个 PC 得分最高和最低的视频 ────────────
cat("\n=== 各 PC 得分最高/最低的视频 ===\n")
for (k in 1:k_90) {
  scores <- pc_scores[, k]
  top10   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE))[1:10]
  bot10   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = FALSE))[1:10]
  cat(paste0("\nPC", k, ":\n"))
  cat("  最高：", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  最低：", paste(bot10, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

```{r}
save_path <- "."
```

```{r}
scree_df <- data.frame(
  PC          = 1:length(eigenvalues),

)
```

```{r}
library(logisticPCA)
save_path <- "."
# ── Step 1: 构建 Correctness 矩阵 ────────────────────
corr_wide <- all_cat %>%
  dplyr::select(Video, participant, key_resp_9.corr) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key_resp_9.corr)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = participant,
              values_from = key_resp_9.corr,
              values_fn   = mean)

corr_matrix <- corr_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Video") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("Correctness 矩阵维度：", dim(corr_matrix), "\n")
cat("缺失值数量：", sum(is.na(corr_matrix)), "\n")

# ── Step 2: Cross-validation 选最优 k ────────────────
logpca_cv <- cv.lpca(corr_matrix, ks = 1:10, ms = 4)
plot(logpca_cv)
k_opt <- which.min(rowMeans(logpca_cv))
cat("最优 k：", k_opt, "\n")

# ── Step 3: 跑 Logistic PCA ───────────────────────────
logpca_model <- logisticPCA(corr_matrix, k = k_opt, m = 4)

# ── Step 4: 每个视频的 PC 得分 ───────────────────────
pc_scores_corr <- logpca_model$PCs
rownames(pc_scores_corr) <- rownames(corr_matrix)

cat("\n=== 各 PC 得分最高/最低的视频 ===\n")
for (k in 1:k_opt) {
  scores <- pc_scores_corr[, k]
  top10   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE))[1:10]
  bot10   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = FALSE))[1:10]
  cat(paste0("\nPC", k, ":\n"))
  cat("  最高：", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  最低：", paste(bot10, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# ── Step 5: 方差解释 ──────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== 方差解释 ===\n")
var_exp <- logpca_model$prop_deviance_expl
cat("各 PC 解释的方差比例：\n")
print(round(var_exp, 3))

# ── Step 6: 保存 ─────────────────────────────────────
pc_scores_corr_df <- as.data.frame(pc_scores_corr)
pc_scores_corr_df$Video <- rownames(corr_matrix)
pc_scores_corr_df <- pc_scores_corr_df %>% dplyr::select(Video, everything())

write.csv(pc_scores_corr_df,
          file.path(save_path, "sensor_correctness_logisticPCA_scores.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n完成！Logistic PCA scores 已保存\n")
```

```{r}
# ── Step 5.5: Scree Plot ──────────────────────────────
max_k <- 20
var_by_k <- numeric(max_k)

for (k in 1:max_k) {
  m <- logisticPCA(corr_matrix, k = k, m = 4)
  var_by_k[k] <- m$prop_deviance_expl
}

# 每个 PC 新增的边际方差
marginal_var <- c(var_by_k[1], diff(var_by_k))

scree_df_corr <- data.frame(
  PC           = 1:max_k,
  Marginal_Var = marginal_var
)

p_scree_corr <- ggplot(scree_df_corr, aes(x = PC, y = Marginal_Var)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:max_k) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent,
                     limits = c(0, NA), expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Scree Plot - Correctness Logistic PCA",
       x = "Component Number",
       y = "Marginal Variance Explained") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    axis.line   = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks  = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

print(p_scree_corr)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "correctness_logisticPCA_scree.pdf"),
  plot = p_scree_corr, width = 90, height = 80, units = "mm",
  dpi = 300, device = cairo_pdf
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "correctness_logisticPCA_scree.png"),
  plot = p_scree_corr, width = 90, height = 80, units = "mm",
  dpi = 300
)
cat("Correctness Scree plot 已保存！\n")
```


```{r}
# 扩大 k 的范围重新 CV
logpca_cv2 <- cv.lpca(corr_matrix, ks = 1:20, ms = 4)
plot(logpca_cv2)

# 手动看哪里有肘部
cv_means <- rowMeans(logpca_cv2)
cat("各 k 的 CV 得分：\n")
print(round(cv_means, 2))

# 用肘部法则找最优 k
# 计算斜率变化
diffs <- diff(cv_means)
diffs2 <- diff(diffs)
k_elbow <- which.min(diffs2) + 1
cat("肘部法则建议 k =", k_elbow, "\n")

# 或者选择方差解释达到 80% 的最小 k
# 重新跑不同 k 看方差解释
for (k in c(3, 5, 7, 10, 15, 20)) {
  m <- logisticPCA(corr_matrix, k = k, m = 4)
  cat(paste0("k=", k, ": 方差解释 = ", round(m$prop_deviance_expl, 3), "\n"))
}
```

建议用 k=15，理由：

解释 81.6% 方差，超过 80% 阈值
与 CAT (k=15) 一致，便于跨任务比较
CV 曲线在 k=15-17 附近略有趋缓

```{r}
# 用 k=7 重新跑 Logistic PCA
logpca_final <- logisticPCA(corr_matrix, k = 15, m = 4)

cat("方差解释：", round(logpca_final$prop_deviance_expl, 3), "\n")

# PC scores
pc_scores_corr_final <- logpca_final$PCs
rownames(pc_scores_corr_final) <- rownames(corr_matrix)

cat("\n=== 各 PC 得分最高/最低的视频 ===\n")
for (k in 1:15) {
  scores <- pc_scores_corr_final[, k]
  top3   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]
  bot3   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = FALSE))[1:3]

  cat("  最高：", paste(top3, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  最低：", paste(bot3, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# 保存
pc_scores_corr_df <- as.data.frame(pc_scores_corr_final)
colnames(pc_scores_corr_df) <- paste0("PC", 1:15)
pc_scores_corr_df$Video <- rownames(corr_matrix)
pc_scores_corr_df <- pc_scores_corr_df %>% dplyr::select(Video, everything())

write.csv(pc_scores_corr_df,
          file.path(save_path, "sensor_correctness_logisticPCA_k15.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n完成！k=15 的 Logistic PCA scores 已保存\n")
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# PC1/PC2/PC3 flat biplots for videos
# 每个点 = 一个视频；颜色 = 标准化后在 |PC1|, |PC2|, |PC3| 中最大的 Dominant PC
# =========================================================
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)

save_path <- "."

clean_video_id <- function(video) {
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(video))
}

make_short_game <- function(game) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(game, regex("HotAir", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "HB",
    stringr::str_detect(game, regex("MovingAround", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "MA",
    stringr::str_detect(game, regex("RotatingCup", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Cup",
    stringr::str_detect(game, regex("Box", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Box",
    TRUE ~ stringr::str_replace_all(game, "\\s+", "")
  )
}

make_short_object <- function(object) {
  object <- stringr::str_to_lower(object)
  dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(object, "yellow cylinder") ~ "YellowCyl",
    stringr::str_detect(object, "magenta cylinder.*cyan|cyan.*magenta cylinder") ~ "MagCyl+CyanCube",
    stringr::str_detect(object, "magenta cylinder") ~ "MagCyl",
    stringr::str_detect(object, "magenta torus") ~ "MagTorus",
    stringr::str_detect(object, "black.*pink.*pyramid") ~ "BlackPinkPyr",
    stringr::str_detect(object, "yellow cube.*pink pyramid|pink pyramid.*yellow cube") ~ "YellowCube+PinkPyr",
    stringr::str_detect(object, "pink pyramid") ~ "PinkPyr",
    stringr::str_detect(object, "cyan") ~ "CyanCube",
    stringr::str_detect(object, "yellow cube") ~ "YellowCube",
    stringr::str_detect(object, "green sphere") ~ "GreenSphere",
    stringr::str_detect(object, "orange.*green") ~ "OrangeGreenSphere",
    stringr::str_detect(object, "black.*pink.*sphere") ~ "BlackPinkSphere",
    stringr::str_detect(object, "green cone") ~ "GreenCone",
    stringr::str_detect(object, "empty") ~ "Empty",
    TRUE ~ stringr::str_to_title(stringr::str_replace_all(object, "[^a-z0-9]+", ""))
  )
}

build_sensor_video_labels <- function(xlsx_file = file.path(save_path, "sensor_pc123.xlsx")) {
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(xlsx_file)

  bind_rows(lapply(sheets, function(sheet_name) {
    readxl::read_excel(xlsx_file, sheet = sheet_name) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Source_sheet = sheet_name)
  })) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Video_name = clean_video_id(Video),
      Game_short = make_short_game(Game_name),
      Object_short = make_short_object(Object),
      Plausibility_short = dplyr::case_when(
        stringr::str_detect(Plausibility, regex("^Plaus", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "P",
        stringr::str_detect(Plausibility, regex("^Implaus", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "I",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      Semantic_label = paste(Game_short, Object_short, Plausibility_short, sep = "-")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Video_name) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(Video_name, Semantic_label, Concept, Game_name, Camera, Plausibility, Object)
}

sensor_video_labels <- build_sensor_video_labels()

make_pc123_flat_biplot <- function(scores_file, title, output_prefix,
                                   pc_cols = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"),
                                   label_n_per_pc = 6,
                                   plot_width = 10.5,
                                   plot_height = 7.5,
                                   label_size = 4.0,
                                   axis_expand_x = 1.22,
                                   axis_expand_y = 1.22,
                                   label_nudge_y = 0,
                                   pc1_label_x = 0.92,
                                   pc1_label_y = 0.09,
                                   pc2_label_x = -0.06,
                                   pc2_label_y = 0.96,
                                   pc3_label_x = 0.50,
                                   pc3_label_y = 0.60,
                                   dim_names = c(PC1 = "Dim 1", PC2 = "Dim 2", PC3 = "Dim 3"),
                                   label_source = c("semantic", "hash"),
                                   special_label_right = character(0),
                                   special_label_nudge_x = 0.025,
                                   special_label_nudge_y = 0.035,
                                   special_label_hjust = 0,
                                   label_box_padding = 0.42,
                                   label_point_padding = 0.25,
                                   label_force = 2.2,
                                   label_force_pull = 0.06,
                                   label_max_time = 2) {
  label_source <- match.arg(label_source)
  scores_raw <- read.csv(file.path(save_path, scores_file), check.names = FALSE)

  scores_df <- scores_raw %>%
    dplyr::select(Video, dplyr::all_of(pc_cols)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(PC1 = !!pc_cols[1], PC2 = !!pc_cols[2], PC3 = !!pc_cols[3])

  pc_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(scores_df[, c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")]))
  colnames(pc_scaled) <- paste0(c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"), "_z")

  scores_df <- bind_cols(scores_df, pc_scaled) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Video_name = clean_video_id(Video),
      Dominant_PC = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")[
        max.col(abs(dplyr::pick(PC1_z, PC2_z, PC3_z)), ties.method = "first")
      ],
      Dominant_PC = factor(Dominant_PC, levels = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(sensor_video_labels, by = "Video_name") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Video_label = dplyr::if_else(
        label_source == "semantic" & !is.na(Semantic_label),
        Semantic_label,
        stringr::str_sub(Video_name, 1, 12)
      ),
      Dominant_Dimension = factor(
        dplyr::recode(as.character(Dominant_PC), !!!as.list(dim_names)),
        levels = unname(dim_names)
      )
    )

  write.csv(
    scores_df %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Video, Video_name, Video_label, Concept, Game_name, Camera, Plausibility, Object,
        PC1, PC2, PC3, PC1_z, PC2_z, PC3_z, Dominant_PC, Dominant_Dimension
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(Dominant_PC, dplyr::desc(abs(PC1) + abs(PC2) + abs(PC3))),
    file.path(save_path, paste0(output_prefix, "_pc123_video_groups.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  label_df <- bind_rows(lapply(c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"), function(pc) {
    scores_df %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(.data[[pc]]))) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = label_n_per_pc) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Label_for = pc)
  })) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Video, .keep_all = TRUE)

  special_label_df <- label_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Video_label %in% special_label_right)
  label_df_general <- label_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!Video %in% special_label_df$Video)

  axis_lim_x <- max(abs(scores_df$PC1), na.rm = TRUE) * axis_expand_x
  axis_lim_y <- max(abs(scores_df$PC2), na.rm = TRUE) * axis_expand_y
  arrow_x <- axis_lim_x * 0.86
  arrow_y <- axis_lim_y * 0.86

  pc_cols_plot <- c(PC1 = "#D55E00", PC2 = "#0072B2", PC3 = "#009E73")
  names(pc_cols_plot) <- unname(dim_names)
  arrow_dim_names <- dim_names
  arrow_dim_names[] <- stringr::str_replace(dim_names, ": ", ":\n")

  p <- ggplot(scores_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Dominant_Dimension, fill = Dominant_Dimension)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.45) +
    stat_ellipse(
      geom = "polygon", type = "norm", level = 0.68,
      alpha = 0.12, linewidth = 1.1, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2.6, alpha = 0.85) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df_general,
      aes(label = Video_label),
      size = label_size, color = "black", max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = label_box_padding, point.padding = label_point_padding,
      nudge_y = axis_lim_y * label_nudge_y,
      force = label_force,
      force_pull = label_force_pull,
      max.time = label_max_time,
      max.iter = 10000,
      min.segment.length = Inf,
      segment.color = NA,
      seed = 42,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = special_label_df,
      aes(label = Video_label),
      size = label_size,
      color = "black",
      hjust = special_label_hjust,
      nudge_x = axis_lim_x * special_label_nudge_x,
      nudge_y = axis_lim_y * special_label_nudge_y,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    annotate("segment", x = 0, y = 0, xend = arrow_x, yend = 0,
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.28, "cm")), linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    annotate("segment", x = 0, y = 0, xend = 0, yend = arrow_y,
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.28, "cm")), linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    annotate("segment", x = 0, y = 0, xend = arrow_x * 0.62, yend = arrow_y * 0.62,
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.28, "cm")), linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = arrow_x * pc1_label_x, y = axis_lim_y * pc1_label_y, label = arrow_dim_names[["PC1"]], size = 4.4, hjust = 0, lineheight = 0.92) +
    annotate("text", x = axis_lim_x * pc2_label_x, y = arrow_y * pc2_label_y, label = arrow_dim_names[["PC2"]], size = 4.4, hjust = 1, lineheight = 0.92) +
    annotate("text", x = arrow_x * pc3_label_x, y = arrow_y * pc3_label_y, label = arrow_dim_names[["PC3"]], size = 4.4, lineheight = 0.92) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pc_cols_plot) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pc_cols_plot) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
      fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-axis_lim_x, axis_lim_x), ylim = c(-axis_lim_y, axis_lim_y), clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = dim_names[["PC1"]],
      y = dim_names[["PC2"]],
      color = "Dominant Dimension",
      fill = "Dominant Dimension"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24, hjust = 0),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, margin = margin(t = 12, b = 6)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, margin = margin(r = 12)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey86", linewidth = 0.55),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.35),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.48, "cm"),
      legend.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 4, b = 0, l = 4),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 34, 28, 18)
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_pc123_flat_biplot.png")),
         plot = p, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_pc123_flat_biplot.pdf")),
         plot = p, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, device = cairo_pdf)

  invisible(scores_df)
}

rt_pc123_groups <- make_pc123_flat_biplot(
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Video RSM matrix plots
# =========================================================
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

save_path <- "."

clean_video_id_rsm <- function(video) {
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(video))
}

make_grouped_rsm_order <- function(rsm, group_file, move_mean_range_to_end = NULL,
                                   order_mode = c("grouped", "global"),
                                   group_order = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")) {
  order_mode <- match.arg(order_mode)
  group_order <- intersect(group_order, c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"))
  if (length(group_order) == 0) group_order <- c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")

  group_df <- read.csv(file.path(save_path, group_file), check.names = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Video_key = clean_video_id_rsm(Video),
      Dim_code = dplyr::case_when(
        Dominant_PC == "PC1" ~ "D1",
        Dominant_PC == "PC2" ~ "D2",
        Dominant_PC == "PC3" ~ "D3",
        TRUE ~ "DX"
      ),
      Axis_label = Video_label
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Video_key %in% clean_video_id_rsm(rownames(rsm)))

  rsm_keys <- clean_video_id_rsm(rownames(rsm))
  names(rsm_keys) <- rownames(rsm)

  group_df <- group_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Video_full = names(rsm_keys)[match(Video_key, rsm_keys)]) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Video_full))

  dim_levels <- group_order

  if (order_mode == "global") {
    rsm_for_order <- rsm
    rsm_for_order[is.na(rsm_for_order)] <- 0
    ordered_videos <- rownames(rsm_for_order)[
      hclust(as.dist(1 - rsm_for_order), method = "average")$order
    ]
    group_sizes <- integer(0)
  } else {
    ordered_videos <- unlist(lapply(dim_levels, function(pc) {
      vids <- group_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(Dominant_PC == pc) %>%
        dplyr::pull(Video_full)

      pc_ordered <- if (length(vids) <= 2) {
        vids
      } else {
        sub_rsm <- rsm[vids, vids, drop = FALSE]
        sub_rsm[is.na(sub_rsm)] <- 0
        vids[hclust(as.dist(1 - sub_rsm), method = "average")$order]
      }

      if (!is.null(move_mean_range_to_end) && length(pc_ordered) > 0) {
        mean_sim <- rowMeans(rsm[pc_ordered, rownames(rsm), drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
        move_to_group_end <- pc_ordered[
          mean_sim >= move_mean_range_to_end[1] &
            mean_sim <= move_mean_range_to_end[2]
        ]
        pc_ordered <- c(setdiff(pc_ordered, move_to_group_end), move_to_group_end)
      }

      pc_ordered
    }), use.names = FALSE)
  }

  missing_videos <- setdiff(rownames(rsm), ordered_videos)
  video_order <- c(ordered_videos, missing_videos)
  move_to_end <- character(0)

  if (!is.null(move_mean_range_to_end) && order_mode == "global") {
    mean_sim <- rowMeans(rsm[video_order, video_order, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    move_to_end <- video_order[
      mean_sim >= move_mean_range_to_end[1] &
        mean_sim <= move_mean_range_to_end[2]
    ]
    video_order <- c(setdiff(video_order, move_to_end), move_to_end)
  }

  if (order_mode == "global") {
    group_sizes <- integer(0)
  } else {
    group_lookup <- group_df$Dominant_PC
    names(group_lookup) <- group_df$Video_full
    group_for_boundary <- unname(group_lookup[video_order])
    group_for_boundary[is.na(group_for_boundary)] <- "Missing"
    group_sizes <- rle(group_for_boundary)$lengths
  }

  label_lookup <- group_df$Axis_label
  names(label_lookup) <- group_df$Video_full
  video_labels <- dplyr::coalesce(
    unname(label_lookup[video_order]),
    paste0("DX-", stringr::str_sub(clean_video_id_rsm(video_order), 1, 10))
  )
  video_labels <- make.unique(video_labels, sep = ".")

  list(order = video_order, labels = video_labels, group_sizes = group_sizes)
}

plot_rsm_matrix <- function(rsm, title, output_prefix, palette = c("red_yellow_blue", "white_blue"),
                            group_file = NULL,
                            draw_group_lines = TRUE,
                            move_mean_range_to_end = NULL,
                            order_mode = c("grouped", "global"),
                            group_order = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")) {
  palette <- match.arg(palette)
  order_mode <- match.arg(order_mode)

  diag(rsm) <- 1
  rsm[is.na(rsm)] <- 0

  if (is.null(group_file)) {
    rsm_dist <- as.dist(1 - rsm)
    video_order <- rownames(rsm)[hclust(rsm_dist, method = "average")$order]
    video_labels <- stringr::str_sub(clean_video_id_rsm(video_order), 1, 10)
    group_sizes <- integer(0)
  } else {
    grouped_order <- make_grouped_rsm_order(rsm, group_file, move_mean_range_to_end, order_mode, group_order)
    video_order <- grouped_order$order
    video_labels <- grouped_order$labels
    group_sizes <- grouped_order$group_sizes
  }

  rsm_ordered <- rsm[video_order, video_order, drop = FALSE]

  rsm_long <- as.data.frame(rsm_ordered) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Video_row") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-Video_row, names_to = "Video_col", values_to = "Similarity") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Video_row = factor(Video_row, levels = rev(video_order), labels = rev(video_labels)),
      Video_col = factor(Video_col, levels = video_order, labels = video_labels)
    )

  fill_scale <- if (palette == "red_yellow_blue") {
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("#EF3B2C", "#FDAE61", "#FFFFBF", "#ABD9E9", "#2166AC"),
      limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
      name = "Similarity"
    )
  } else {
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#2171B5", "#08306B"),
      values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1)),
      limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
      name = "Similarity"
    )
  }

  group_breaks_x <- cumsum(group_sizes)
  group_breaks_x <- group_breaks_x[group_breaks_x < length(video_order)] + 0.5
  group_breaks_y <- length(video_order) - cumsum(group_sizes)
  group_breaks_y <- group_breaks_y[group_breaks_y > 0] + 0.5
  group_bounds <- if (length(group_sizes) > 0) {
    x_start <- c(1, head(cumsum(group_sizes), -1) + 1)
    x_end <- cumsum(group_sizes)
    tibble::tibble(
      xmin = x_start - 0.5,
      xmax = x_end + 0.5,
      ymin = length(video_order) - x_end + 0.5,
      ymax = length(video_order) - x_start + 1.5
    )
  } else {
    tibble::tibble(xmin = numeric(), xmax = numeric(), ymin = numeric(), ymax = numeric())
  }

  p <- ggplot(rsm_long, aes(x = Video_col, y = Video_row, fill = Similarity)) +
    geom_tile() +
    fill_scale +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 55, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 6.8, color = "grey30"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.0, color = "grey30"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.key.height = unit(1.0, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(18, 20, 18, 18)
    )

  if (draw_group_lines && length(group_breaks_x) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_rect(
        data = group_bounds,
        aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        fill = NA,
        color = "white",
        linewidth = 1.35
      )
  }

  print(p)

  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_video_RSM.png")),
         plot = p, width = 11, height = 12, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_video_RSM.pdf")),
         plot = p, width = 11, height = 12, device = cairo_pdf)

  write.csv(rsm_ordered, file.path(save_path, paste0(output_prefix, "_video_RSM_matrix.csv")))

  invisible(rsm)
}

# RT RSM: 视频之间的 Pearson correlation，rescale 到 0-1
rt_wide_saved <- read.csv(file.path(save_path, "rt_wide.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
rt_matrix_saved <- rt_wide_saved %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Video") %>%
  as.matrix()
rt_z_saved <- scale(rt_matrix_saved, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
rt_rsm <- cor(t(rt_z_saved), method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
rt_rsm <- (rt_rsm + 1) / 2
rt_rsm <- pmin(pmax(rt_rsm, 0), 1)

plot_rsm_matrix(
  rsm = rt_rsm,
  title = "Action - RT Video RSM",
  output_prefix = "sensor_RT",
  palette = "red_yellow_blue",
  group_file = "sensor_RT_PCA_pc123_video_groups.csv",
  draw_group_lines = TRUE,
  order_mode = "grouped"
)

# Correctness RSM: 1 - 视频间平均绝对差
corr_wide_saved <- read.csv(file.path(save_path, "corr_wide.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
corr_matrix_saved <- corr_wide_saved %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Video") %>%
  as.matrix()

video_ids <- rownames(corr_matrix_saved)
corr_rsm <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = length(video_ids),
  ncol = length(video_ids),
  dimnames = list(video_ids, video_ids)
)

for (i in seq_along(video_ids)) {
  for (j in i:length(video_ids)) {
    xi <- corr_matrix_saved[i, ]
    xj <- corr_matrix_saved[j, ]
    keep <- !is.na(xi) & !is.na(xj)
    sim <- if (sum(keep) == 0) NA_real_ else 1 - mean(abs(xi[keep] - xj[keep]))
    corr_rsm[i, j] <- sim
    corr_rsm[j, i] <- sim
  }
}

corr_rsm <- pmin(pmax(corr_rsm, 0), 1)

plot_rsm_matrix(
  rsm = corr_rsm,
  title = "Action - Correctness Video RSM",
  output_prefix = "sensor_correctness",
  palette = "red_yellow_blue",
  group_file = "sensor_correctness_logisticPCA_pc123_video_groups.csv",
  draw_group_lines = TRUE,
  order_mode = "grouped",
  group_order = c("PC1", "PC3", "PC2"),
  move_mean_range_to_end = c(0.35, 0.65)
)

cat("完成！已保存 RT 和 Correctness 的 Video RSM matrix 图和对应矩阵 CSV。\n")
```
